{{nihongo|'''Ishifu Shrine'''|伊志夫神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Ishifu Shrine''' (いしふじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Ishibu, {{ill|Matsuzaki, Shizuoka|arz|ماتسوزاكى|es|Matsuzaki|fa|ماتسوزاکی، شیزوئوکا|fr|Matsuzaki|id|Matsuzaki, Shizuoka|it|Matsuzaki|ja|松崎町|ko|마쓰자키정|ms|Matsuzaki, Shizuoka|pl|Matsuzaki|ru|Мацудзаки|tl|Matsuzaki, Shizuoka|tr|Matsuzaki|uk|Мацудзакі (Сідзуока)|ur|ماتسوزاکی، شیزوکا|zh|松崎町|zh_yue|松崎|qid=Q1204017}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Shizuoka|ar|مقاطعة كامو (شيزوكا)|ceb|Kamo-gun (distrito sa Hapon, Shizuoka-ken)|fa|ناحیه کامو، شیزوئوکا|fr|District de Kamo (Shizuoka)|id|Distrik Kamo, Shizuoka|it|Distretto di Kamo (Shizuoka)|ja|賀茂郡|ko|가모군 (시즈오카현)|pl|Powiat Kamo (Shizuoka)|ru|Камо (Сидзуока)|uk|Повіт Камо (Сідзуока)|zh|賀茂郡|qid=Q961511}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401148 伊志夫神社] - Shizuoka Prefectural Shrine Office</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined on the southwestern mountain foot of the Ishibu district in the southwest of Matsuzaki.

Its founding is unknown, but it is an old shrine identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} of the same name, Ishifu Shrine (いしふじんじゃ), and it is also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Ishihi no Myōjin"<ref name="town">[https://www.town.matsuzaki.shizuoka.jp/docs/2021022200016/ 伊志夫神社] - Matsuzaki Town</ref><ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/kunihasira_title.htm 伊志夫神社] - Genbu</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140314-01.html 伊志夫神社] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.

In the Muromachi period it was called "Ishibi Daimyōjin"; in the Edo period, "Ishibu Daimyōjin" and "Mishima Daimyōjin"<ref name="town"/><ref name="engi"/>.
